{{Top|leg}}
'''Debri-X Retinal Scanners''' were security devices that used an individual's retinal scan. The scanner could be fooled by anyone wearing a [[retinal disguiser]]. The [[Ariana Precious Metals Repository]] on [[Woostri]] made use of Debri-X Retinal Scanners, and were the target of a heist planned by the criminal [[Heler]].<ref name="GFT">''[[Gundark's Fantastic Technology: Personal Gear]]''</ref>
